question: Why do most OLED televisions use white light behind colour filters, unlike OLED phones?
answer: Because the phone method does not scale. Phone makers evaporate red, green and blue materials through a fine metal mask, a sheet of alloy pierced with millions of holes, one per subpixel. Across a television-sized glass the mask sags and shifts with heat, so LG lays down one white-emitting stack everywhere and filters it.
move: A process that works at one size can fail purely because of size.
source: Tsujimura, OLED Display Fundamentals and Applications, 2017
reference: Tsujimura, OLED Display Fundamentals and Applications, 2nd edition, Wiley, 2017
